leverage_model: allowed: position sizing uses equity * position_pct for every accepted entry and does not reserve/deduct cash; exposure can exceed 100% subject to max_open_positions and max_new_positions_per_day

atr_trail.stop_formula: highest_high_since_entry - atr_multiple * current_ATR; updated after each close and active next session

n_day_low.stop_formula: previous N trading days' lowest low; shifted 1 day so the stop is known before the session

hold_days.fill: close of the Nth trading day after entry

rsi2_threshold.fill: close of the signal day when daily RSI2 is above threshold

same_day_stop.description: If entry day low touches initial stop, stop out only when the entry day candle is red (close < open). Green/doji candle does not trigger same-day stop.
